entries.name: MedStrata AI
entries.text: Founder and CEO. Building the fully autonomous back office for independent pharmacies. 1M+ claims analyzed and $23K+ in identified savings and revenue recovery opportunities.

entries.name: SDR, Empower Sleep
entries.text: For 4 months, booked 4 to 10 qualified meetings a day for our account executive. Learned to sell into healthcare.

entries.name: Insuraflow AI
entries.text: Claude brought coding back for me. Built an AI operating system for life insurance agents to compete with GoHighLevel. Too ambitious for the wrong audience, and the co-founder relationship ended badly.

entries.name: Smart Frost Film
entries.text: Resold smart film that switches glass from clear to frosted with a remote. Sold 3 customers. The supplier never delivered, and no one else could match the price. Shut it down to focus on building a tech company.

entries.name: Life insurance agent and team lead
entries.text: Got licensed, built a team of 6 agents, and ran our own Facebook ads system. Best month: over $30,000. Then chargebacks hit, and it fell apart.

entries.name: Graduated high school
entries.text: Skipped college. Everything since, I taught myself.

entries.name: Appointment setter, life insurance
entries.text: Booked qualified appointments for a life insurance agent at $100 each.

entries.name: Real estate marketing agency
entries.text: A few older friends of mine were real estate agents who couldn't get Facebook ads to bring in leads. I figured it out, then sold them ads and leads. Grew to 12 agent clients and $15K MRR at peak. Built their GoHighLevel CRMs and Zapier automations.

entries.name: Oasis VRX
entries.text: First job, at a VR arcade.

entries.name: E-commerce
entries.text: Built and ran online stores. Most lost to competition.

entries.name: Prime High School Fantasy Sports
entries.text: At 13, taught myself JavaScript and spent 8 months building a fantasy sports and betting app for my friends and their dads. It worked. Apple rejected it. Betting apps have to come from licensed companies, and I was a 13-year-old with a laptop.

about.heading: About me
about.sub: 20-year-old founder and builder · Red Bank, New Jersey
about.background: I taught myself to code at 13 and skipped college to learn by building. Seven ventures and plenty of hard lessons later, I'm still at it.
